name: Standup Sync
author: Northwind Automations
description: Posts a short daily standup line to your local team dashboard - how many tasks are open and which one has been waiting longest.

invocation.when_to_use: When the user wants to post, push or sync a standup update to their team dashboard, or asks to let the team know where their tasks stand.

dashboard_url.description: The local dashboard endpoint to post the standup line to.

capabilities.reason: Reads your tasks to count the open ones and find the oldest.
Posts the standup line to your local team dashboard.
